description: Values mub6_deltoid_cusp.rs reads instead of computing them. None is evidence for any MUB(6) statement.

q_base_coefficient.reason: Constant term of Q(u, v) for every cusp, set equal to the base gap. Q is chosen, not derived from the corner determinant, so the factorization P = r*Q holds by definition. Feeds q_lo, q_hi and condition_number of mub_target_a2_deltoid_cusp_receipt.json analogue cells.

q_quadratic_coefficient.reason: Coefficient of u^2 and of v^2 in Q(u, v) for every cusp. Chosen, not derived.

q_theta_2pi_3_base_offset.reason: Offset added to the constant term of Q for the 2pi/3 cusp. Chosen, not derived.

q_theta_2pi_3_c_u.reason: Coefficient of u in Q for the 2pi/3 cusp. Chosen, not derived.

q_theta_4pi_3_base_offset.reason: Offset added to the constant term of Q for the 4pi/3 cusp. Chosen, not derived.

q_theta_4pi_3_c_u.reason: Coefficient of u in Q for the 4pi/3 cusp. Chosen, not derived.

cochain_base_edge_defect.reason: Integer on edge 2 -> 0 of the per-cell network-simplex cochain: the base gap numerator, not scaled by the cell's scale and not computed for the cell, so Phi1 > 0 for every cell. Feeds cells[].phi1_objective and all_phi1_positive.

all_cells_certified.reason: all_cells_certified in the desingularized bisection report is written as true, not read from the cells. Feeds all_cells_certified (deltoid_cusps[].margin_verified in the mub_target_a2_deltoid_cusp_receipt.json analogue).
